_note: Hand-curated. Roll ids are chosen by reading the Clerk's titles; her vote is pulled from data/votes.json, never typed here. statementRx matches titles; statementPicks adds specific releases with a verbatim snippet found by 'rx' in the release's full text (data/statements_full.json). No editorial verdicts except the Israel card's headline, set in 'israel.headline'.

issues.name: Tariffs and emergency powers
issues.intro: Votes on whether Congress should end national emergencies the President declared to impose tariffs. On H.J.Res. 117 the question was a motion to table (set aside) the motion to discharge, so a Yea kept the House from voting on the resolution itself. H.J.Res. 72 would end the February 1, 2025 emergency behind the Canada tariffs.

issues.name: Health care and Medicaid
issues.intro: The 2025 reconciliation law, H.R. 1 (Public Law 119-21), which includes Medicaid changes, and two Republican health bills.

issues.name: Spending, rescissions and funding deadlines
issues.intro: Votes on the 2025 rescissions package, continuing resolutions and full-year appropriations.

issues.name: Immigration and the border
issues.intro: Final votes on immigration enforcement bills and on a bill to require Temporary Protected Status for Haiti.

issues.name: Elections and voting
issues.intro: Votes on proof-of-citizenship and noncitizen-voting bills. The Jan. 6, 2021 votes on the 2020 electoral count are on the Allegiance page.

issues.name: War powers, Ukraine and foreign policy
issues.intro: Every war powers resolution the House voted on this Congress, plus the Ukraine Support Act. A Yea on a war powers resolution directs the President to remove U.S. forces from the hostilities it names.

issues.name: Executive power, courts and the federal workforce
issues.intro: Votes on limiting court orders, packaging disapproval of late-term regulations, and restoring collective bargaining for federal employees.

issues.name: Abortion and family policy
issues.intro: Final votes on the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act and two bills on pregnant and parenting women and students.

issues.name: The Epstein files
issues.intro: The vote on the Epstein Files Transparency Act, which required release of the Justice Department's Epstein files after a discharge petition forced the vote.
